blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in North Coquitlam. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

North Coquitlam, Coquitlam: 149 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 11 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 2 of 23 Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in North Coquitlam rose from 147 in June to 149 in September, and 86 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 18.5% of Coquitlam’s 806 condos and townhomes listed.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in North Coquitlam?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 149 condos and townhomes listed in North Coquitlam. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is North Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in North Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in North Coquitlam from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 86 condos and townhomes sold in North Coquitlam over those 4 months, out of 475 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
